India loses T20 series to England; captain cites mistakes

India has lost a T20 series against England for the first time. Following the loss, captain Shreyas Iyer stated that mistakes were made. The team faced delays reaching the stadium for the fifth T20 match in Southampton due to traffic. Despite losing the series, the team aimed to end the tour with a win. Weather forecasts indicated a possibility of rain affecting the final match.
